entries.question: Addmission process
entries.answer:

**Salah:** Aap samay-samay par [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) dekhte rahein taaki aapko naye admission form ki jaankari mil sake. 

Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya KGMU AI Assistant hoon. Agar aapko kisi specific course ka naam pata hai, toh batayein, main usse sambandhit adhik jaankari dene ki koshish karunga.

entries.question: Holidays in 2026
entries.answer:
The KGMU 2026 holiday calendar is divided into General (Gazetted) Holidays and Restricted (Optional) Holidays.

### **General (Gazetted) Holidays 2026**
On these days, OPD and OT services are closed, and there are no classes. Emergency services remain operational 24/7.

*   **Jan:** Hazrat Ali Birthday (03), Republic Day (26)
*   **Feb:** Mahashivratri (15)
*   **Mar:** Holika Dahan (02), Holi (04), Eid-ul-Fitr (20/21), Ram Navami (31)
*   **Apr:** Mahavir Jayanti (03), Good Friday (03), Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Jayanti (14)
*   **May:** Buddha Purnima (01), Mahavir Ji Ka Mela (05), Eid-ul-Zuha (27)
*   **Jun:** Moharram (26)
*   **Aug:** Independence Day (15), Eid-e-Milad (26), Raksha Bandhan (28)
*   **Sep:** Janmashtami (04)
*   **Oct:** Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti (02), Dussehra (20)
*   **Nov:** Diwali (08-09), Govardhan Puja (11), Bhai Dooj/Chitragupta Jayanti (11/12), Guru Nanak Jayanti/Kartik Purnima (24)
*   **Dec:** Christmas Day (25)

### **Restricted (Optional) Holidays 2026**
Staff members may choose any **02 days** from this list with approval from the Dean or CMS. OPD and emergency services remain open on these days.

*   **Jan:** New Year (01), Makar Sankranti (14), Basant Panchami (23/24), Jan Nayak Karpoori Thakur Birthday (24)
*   **Feb:** Sant Ravidas Jayanti (01), Shab-e-Barat (25)
*   **Mar:** Holi Addl. (05), Jamaat-ul-Vida (13), Cheti Chand (19), Eid-ul-Fitr Addl. (22)
*   **Apr:** Easter Saturday (04), Maharishi Kashyap & Nishad Raj Jayanti (05), Easter Monday (06), Chandrashekhar Jayanti (17), Parshuram Jayanti (19)
*   **May:** Maharana Pratap Jayanti (09), Eid-ul-Zuha Addl. (28)
*   **Jun:** Moharram Addl. (25)
*   **Aug:** Chehallum (04)
*   **Sep:** Vishwakarma Puja (17), Anant Chaturdashi (25)
*   **Oct:** Maharaja Agrasen Jayanti (11), Dussehra Mahashtami (19), Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti (26), Sardar Patel & Acharya Narendra Dev Jayanti (31)
*   **Nov:** Narak Chaturdashi (08), Chhath Puja (15/16), Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day (16)
*   **Dec:** Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Urs (16), Chaudhary Charan Singh Birthday (23), Christmas Eve (24)

***Note:** Dates marked with (*) depend on moon sightings and may shift by one day. Residents on emergency duty must report regardless of the holiday status.*
